purpose: Teach: 高まり/渡さ/覆わ/広まっ/害する/根ざし/崩す/利か

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、関心の高まりを医療チームも見ております
lines.en: Ren, we've been noticing your increased interest in how things work here at the clinic.
lines.style: Steady, clear voice with gentle warmth. Speaks from experience without condescension. Measured pace, comfortable pauses between phrases. The kind tone of someone who respects the person across from her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療情報を渡さない患者さんもいるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I've heard some patients don't always share their full medical history with us. Is that right, Doctor?
lines.style: Careful, genuinely curious phrasing. Leans in slightly. Soft energy—not pressing, more like thinking aloud. The tentative confidence of someone learning how to ask real questions.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、傷が皮膚に覆われ始めております
lines.en: That's right. We're seeing the wound begin to close over. The healing process is underway.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery, no drama. Clinical precision softened by warmth underneath. She's stating fact but leaving room for follow-up. Calm, unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 院内に広まった感染、貴院対応されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So when infection spread through the ward, your team handled it well. That must have taken real coordination.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflecting back what he's observed. Slight lift of admiration underneath. Not a question mark at the end—more a quiet recognition. Respectful distance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 健康を害する習慣、医療チームが指導しております
lines.en: Yes. Unhealthy habits can undermine everything else. Our team works to guide patients toward better choices—not push, but guide.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Each word measured. A light emphasis on 'guide' as if distinguishing it from force. Steady eye contact level. The voice of someone who's had this conversation many times and means it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域に根ざした医療、貴院続けておられますね、先生
lines.en: You've really stayed committed to serving the community here, haven't you? That's not easy to sustain.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Slight hesitation before speaking—he's choosing his words carefully. Genuine respect underneath. Warm but not effusive. The observation of someone noticing something real.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 体調を崩す患者さんに医療チームは寄り添います
lines.en: When patients are struggling, our team doesn't just treat them—we're there alongside them. That's how we practice.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not preaching. She's describing something fundamental to how she works. Slight pause before 'we're'—ownership. Calm, grounded, genuinely present in the statement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 薬が利かない症例、貴院研究なさいましたね、先生
lines.en: There are cases where standard medications don't work the way we'd expect. Your hospital's research into those—that's important work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery with underlying respect. Slight rise of genuine interest. He's acknowledging something serious and well-done. Not flattering—observing something real. Quiet warmth.
